name: Defend the Hearth
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn.

needs.what: a combat-only form of the one-shot player damage shield: `combat_only: true` on the `prevent_damage` op (and on structs.DamageShield, read by primitives.damage_player), so a spell can say "prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to players this turn" with player: "any" while noncombat damage to players still lands
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` op (op_options: duration, player) installs a DamageShield that prevents ALL damage to the player, noncombat included, so it would be a strictly better card; `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` static, which lives on a permanent's battlefield statics, matches permanents not players, and has no this-turn duration, so an instant cannot carry it
